limits: Counts overlap in scope; they are not a release completion percentage.
All-lock Python audit does not cover vendored libraries or operating-system packages.
Standalone Redis is qualified; Redis Cluster cross-slot operation and legacy physical orphan cleanup are not certified.
Full local working-tree tests, browser journeys and container builds concern separate private candidates and must not be attributed to this small publication cohort.
Broad hosted CI and production/provider/recovery/endurance gates remain required.
